Author: Jack Luxear
Name: GatherBuddy Ascended
Description: Adds commands to simplify gathering by finding nodes and fish and their locations via item name and a UI to keep track of special uptime and weather conditions. Also automatically gathers items based on these conditions using lists that you specify. Automated gathering requires vnavmesh.
Punchline: Simplify Gathering and Fishing to the extreme.
Changelog:
GatherBuddy Ascended 2.1

• Added automatic craft-list material acquisition from unlocked vendors and marketboards.
• Added purchase estimates, maximum Gil budgets, HQ/NQ/vendor/current-world preferences, multi-world routing, and fail-closed currency/unlock checks.
• Added Marketplace search, persistent buy lists, Universalis price caching, current-world filtering, and typo-tolerant item search.
• Donatello now replans faster, recovers more reliably when craft conditions change, and optimizes collectable gathering for expected scrip yield.
• Added cordial strength ordering, HQ/NQ preference, and an option to avoid wasting GP recovery above the cap.
• Added a default-on option to use every gathering attempt on timed collectables, even after reaching the requested quantity.
• Improved gathering-node navigation and interaction reliability: missing nodes no longer cause repeated movement in place, failed interactions are retried safely, and nodes are only marked complete after a confirmed gathering session.
• Improved auto-crafting and auto-gathering flow, including retainer restocking, material deficits, class selection, repair, navigation, and queue recovery.
• Added earlier errors for missing crafting jobs, gearsets, recipe unlocks, gathering unlocks, unavailable vendors, currencies, and travel requirements.
• Fixed multiple crafting-list, specialist-action, quality-selection, search, navigation, gathering-attempt, and cleanup bugs.
• Improved general plugin stability and compatibility.
